name: Cursed Effigy summons its device instead of nothing
contract: Cursed Effigy 280915 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with EffectMiscValue[0] = 50134, a creature entry with no
creature_template row anywhere in data/sql, so Spell::EffectSummonType silently no-ops: cooldown fires,
nothing spawns. The sibling Witch Doctor ability (creature 50121, same name, same AI pattern) already
periodically casts Cursed Field (506820, -100% crit chance) on nearby enemies, matching the tooltip
('Enemies within X yds are unable to critically strike'), but that AI is gated to CLASS_WITCH_DOCTOR. A new
creature_template for 50134 (cloned stats/model from 50121) with its own, non-gated ScriptName gives the
Wildcard version the same working behaviour. Expected: casting it spawns a 50134 effigy near the caster, and
a nearby enemy loses all melee crit chance while it stands near the effigy.

steps.label: The effigy spawns (entry 50134, not the missing one)
Cursed Field lands on the nearby enemy
